messages:
Maya: Quick check — post-launch notes: EU latency errors up ~18% and ACME asked for extended context window in the demo next Wed. We need to pick: "prioritize stability patch this sprint" or "ship small opt-in enhancement we promised to ACME". Thoughts?

Eli: Do we know if the error spike is rollout-related or a runtime regression? link to logs?

Sanjay: It looks like an autoscaling edge-case in the EU ASG (connection churn causing 5xx on cold paths). I have a fix candidate, low-risk, estimate 36–48h to validate.

Maya: If we go patch-first, ACME misses the demo ask. If we go feature-first, we risk more customer impact.

Keisha: Design for extended context is basically done; we only need confirmation on default window and the opt-in UX copy.

Tom: From infra side the patch reduces 5xxs and token waste. I'd prioritize the hotfix.

Maya: Proposal: two-track approach — 1) emergency hotfix (canary -> rollback plan) to reduce 5xxs, and 2) ship the ACME feature behind an opt-in feature flag so sales keeps demo promise without exposing everyone. Can we do both in ~72h?

Eli: I can add the feature flag and gate the API today if we avoid touching the runtime core. Hotfix ETA 36–48h from Sanjay sounds right.

Sanjay: Canary plan: route 5% EU traffic to patched nodes, monitor for 24h, then expand. Will coordinate with Tom for metrics.

Maya: Great. @Keisha can you mark ACME design as opt-in and prepare the screenshot/copy we send them?

Keisha: Yup — will draft and share in 30m.

DeployBot: Canary deployment started: patch v1.2.1 -> env: eu-prod -> 5% traffic

Tom: Monitoring token throughput + tail latency. Will post if anything abnormal.

Eli: Dev note: adding flag `extended_context_acme` in /flags.json. Snippet: ```{"extended_context_acme": true}```

Maya: Once canary is stable we'll open a follow-up ticket to schedule general availability for the extended context feature next sprint.

Keisha: Also suggest a short line in release notes that the feature is opt-in for early customers.

Maya: Agreed. I'll update the roadmap board and notify sales.

Sanjay: Rollback plan is in place if canary shows regressions. I'll post a short postmortem in #incidents if anything weird happens.

Eli: +1

Tom: :thumbsup:

Keisha: :heart:

DeployBot: Canary reached 24h stable milestone -> status: stable
